description: VERB-3D calculates radiation-belt electron phase-space density through a multidimensional diffusion equation. Its numerical scheme separates relevant diffusion processes for simulations of electron-belt evolution. The resource is documented by UCLA; GFZ German Research Centre for Geosciences. The documented physical domain is Geospace, Magnetosphere / Inner Magnetosphere / RadiationBelt; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The provider identifies more realistic storm-time magnetic fields as a future development need. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
